policies.title: Privacy and Security Policy
policies.tab1Content: Within our privacy policy, we do not send spam. Nor do we request the sending of personal data by email. If you receive any message requesting personal information, please send an email to dpo@smithson.com.br.
policies.tab2Content: In order to improve the quality of navigation and site features, Smithson collects statistical and analytical information, generally related to technical aspects or browsing on the site. Data may be collected and stored through cookies — text files containing identification information stored on your computer — server-side scripts (PHP, ASP, etc.) and client-side (javascript) tools, whether proprietary or third-party. Although cookies are not harmful to your equipment, users are free to refuse their use by accessing their browser settings, as well as preventing the execution of javascript.
policies.tab3Content: Although the company uses external links it believes to be of interest to users of smithson.com.br, the company is not responsible for information collected on external sites that have a link on the Smithson website.
policies.tab4Intro: Smithson do Brasil adopts the following information security policy to ensure that all Information Security objectives are met, namely:
policies.tab4Item1: Establish guidelines and standards that allow employees and service providers to follow desirable and acceptable behavior standards, in accordance with legality and global best practices, in order to mitigate technical and legal risks;
policies.tab4Item2: Guide the definition of specific Information Security procedures and the implementation of controls and processes to meet their requirements;
policies.tab4Item3: Ensure confidentiality, integrity, availability and guidance for the information processing flow throughout its lifecycle, within applicable legal standards;
policies.tab4Item4: Prevent possible incidents and legal liability for the institution and its employees and service providers;
policies.tab4Item5: Ensure the normality and continuity of Smithson's activities, protecting critical processes against significant failures or disasters;
policies.tab4Item6: Meet legal, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to Smithson's activity;
policies.tab4Item7: Minimize the risks of damage, financial loss, market share, client and partner trust, or any other negative impact on Smithson's activities resulting from a security breach;
policies.tab4Item8: Ensure continuous and up-to-date training on Information Security policies and procedures, emphasizing people's obligations regarding their respective security;
policies.tab4Item9: Ensure that all Information Security responsibilities are clearly defined and preserved.
